workcover.name: Limitation period — common law
workcover.special_calc: 3 years from DOI, or 3 years from date of knowledge. Minors: from 18th birthday. Extension under s134AB(26) WIRC Act.
workcover.legislative_basis: Limitation of Actions Act 1958 s5(1AA); WIRC Act 2013 s134AB(26)

workcover.name: Insurer decision on claim
workcover.special_calc: 28 days from properly made claim. Not decided → deemed accepted s103(2).

workcover.name: Payment rate reduction — 13 weeks
workcover.special_calc: Rate drops from 95% to 80% of PIAWE.

workcover.name: Payment rate — 52 weeks
workcover.special_calc: Must demonstrate capacity. Second entitlement period s167.
workcover.consequence: Payments may cease without capacity evidence.

workcover.name: Payments cessation — 130 weeks
workcover.special_calc: Cease unless no current work capacity AND likely indefinite.

workcover.name: Impairment benefit claim
workcover.special_calc: After MMI. Min 10% WPI. AMA 4th Ed.

workcover.name: CoC renewal
workcover.special_calc: Request 7 days before expiry. Gap suspends payments.

tac.name: Limitation period — common law
tac.special_calc: 3 years from accident. Minors: from 18th birthday.
tac.legislative_basis: Limitation of Actions Act 1958 s5(1AAA); TAC Act 1986 s93(1)

tac.name: Serious injury certificate
tac.special_calc: Alternative to impairment threshold. Narrative test.

public_liability.name: Limitation period
public_liability.special_calc: 3 years from cause of action. Discoverability s27D. Extension s27K.
public_liability.legislative_basis: Limitation of Actions Act 1958 s5(1AA); Wrongs Act 1958 Part VBA

tpd.name: Limitation period
tpd.special_calc: 6 years (contract). Check fund deed for internal deadlines (often 12-24mo).

tpd.name: Waiting period
tpd.special_calc: Most policies 3 or 6 months off work. Check policy.

comcare.name: Limitation period — common law
comcare.special_calc: 3 years from date of injury or knowledge. Must elect under s44 SRC Act. Threshold: 10% WPI.
comcare.legislative_basis: Limitation of Actions Act 1958 s5(1AA); SRC Act 1988 s44

comcare.name: Comcare liability determination
comcare.special_calc: Comcare should determine within 6 months. No deemed acceptance — chase actively.

comcare.name: Reconsideration application
comcare.special_calc: 30 days from date of determination. Internal review under s62.
comcare.consequence: Must proceed directly to AAT without internal review.

comcare.name: Permanent impairment claim
comcare.special_calc: After MMI. 10% WPI threshold for lump sum.

medical_negligence.name: Limitation period
medical_negligence.special_calc: 3 years from discoverability (s27D Limitation Act). NOT necessarily from treatment date. Date patient knew or ought to have known.
medical_negligence.legislative_basis: Limitation of Actions Act 1958 s5(1AA), s27D

medical_negligence.name: Pre-court notice response period
medical_negligence.special_calc: Defendant has 90 days to respond to pre-court notice. Cannot issue proceedings before expiry unless urgent.

medical_negligence.name: Significant injury threshold
medical_negligence.special_calc: Narrative test s28LE Wrongs Act. Same as public liability.

compliance.name: Initial costs disclosure
compliance.special_calc: ASAP after instructions. Before substantial work.
